description: The donut chart, titled “Task Type,” visually represents the distribution of generative AI applications in journalism as categorized in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” It displays three distinct task categories: “Article generation,” which dominates the chart with a large red segment (though its exact percentage is not labeled, it visually accounts for the majority, approximately 83%); “Article editing,” shown in blue and explicitly labeled as 14.6%; and “Headline generation,” represented by a small yellow slice labeled 2.4%. The chart uses a central white space with the title “Task Type” in bold, and each segment is clearly labeled with its name and percentage (where available) outside the ring. The “Article generation” label is accompanied by a gray rectangular color key, suggesting it corresponds to the red segment, even though its percentage is not numerically stated. The visual hierarchy emphasizes the overwhelming prevalence of article generation over the other two tasks.
